title: 合并 GitLab 合并请求
summary: 使用已确认的源分支提交 SHA，立即合并指定 MR。
description: Use project_repo_id returned by git_repo_list. Only merge requests whose source and target are in this GitLab project are supported. Use the full source commit SHA you have reviewed, as returned by gitlab.mr.get. Re-read and confirm the new commit on SHA mismatch. If the outcome is unknown, read the MR before retrying. GitLab applies its own permissions and merge checks.
result_description: The MR with iid, title, state, draft, source_branch, target_branch, sha, web_url and detailed_merge_status.
